title: introduce-differential-perturbation-smokehook
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: CI smoke checks for prompt-set regressions today rely on single-output thresholds or coarse ensemble metrics which miss subtle distributional shifts that only appear under small prompt perturbations. This PR adds a lightweight "differential perturbation" smokehook that generates controlled variants of seed prompts (syntactic paraphrases, punctuation/noise, token-order swaps) and performs pairwise delta checks on a configurable set of metrics (log-prob delta, calibrated score delta, semantic similarity delta). The goal is a fast, low-cost CI gate that surfaces regressions caused by model changes, tokenization differences, or prompt-handling tweaks without requiring full eval runs.
Scope:
- new smokehook implementation under eval_harness/hooks/differential_perturbation.py
- config-driven perturbation recipes and metric thresholds in eval_harness/configs/smoke_hooks/differential.yml
- small synthetic labeler utility to compute normalized similarity scores (fallback when golden labels missing)
- CI integration job that runs only on PRs touching model-serving or prompt transformations; job uses a 50-example sampled prompt-set and exits non-zero if any pairwise delta exceeds configured thresholds (can be gated to warning on draft PRs)
- extensive unit tests + a lightweight end-to-end smoke test that runs in ~90s on CI
Why this is different: instead of one-off paraphrase probes or ensemble-only gating, this approach compares each original->perturbed pair and surfaces directionality and magnitude of drift; it is resilient to stable dataset-wide shifts because it looks for inconsistent behavior across perturbations.
Backwards compatibility: default config is conservative (high thresholds) and the hook is disabled for legacy repos by default.
Usage notes: add label "smoke-diff" to enable for a PR or add repo config entry to auto-run.
Checklist: [x] implementation and tests [x] config docs and README snippet [x] CI job and workflow [x] Linear tickets linked (ENG-1137)
Related: SUP-4271 was a customer-reported case where punctuation changes in prompt preprocessing caused a rollout regression.

review_comments: Arjun Patel (reviewer): Nice end-to-end design. Two requests: make thresholds per-recipe (not global) and add an allowlist for noisy prompts that historically flip. Also can you add an opt-out annotation for long-running PRs?
Maya Chen (author reply): Thanks — split thresholds by recipe and added allowlist support via regex in config; added doc note for opt-out annotation (#smoke-diff:skip).
Sofia Martinez (reviewer): CI run failed initially due to a flakey semantic-similarity dependency; suggest vendorizing a small similarity util and adding a deterministic seed. See inline on tests.
Maya Chen (author reply): Vendorized cosine util and added seed + cached embeddings for CI; re-ran tests locally and updated test fixtures.
Ethan Brooks (approver): LGTM after fixing one nit around timeout in the e2e smoke test. Verified workflow exits non-zero when a deterministic delta is injected.
merge_details: Merged by Sofia Martinez via squash merge. Merge commit: squash into main, summary message updated to include usage note. Change was considered non-breaking; release notes mention new optional smokehook and default conservative thresholds.
release_notes: Add differential perturbation smokehook (opt-in) to catch prompt-handling regressions quickly in CI. Default thresholds are conservative; configure per-recipe thresholds in eval_harness/configs/smoke_hooks/differential.yml. Not enabled by default for legacy repos.
notes_for_oncall: If CI starts failing broadly on this new workflow, check semantic similarity vendorized util cache and the sampled prompt set allowlist. To temporarily disable, add label 'smoke-diff:skip' to the failing PR or remove smoke-diff workflow from repo CI config.
